text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How's the length, I wonder? ...Guess I'll 
try it on real quick! ♪

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Eye-chan! The public bath is gonna 
close soon!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai, is that all you're eating today? Wanna 
eat half of Boo's?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four, two, two, three, 
four...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
A-Eye! What's gotten into you lately? 
You're pushing yourself way too hard, I'm 
worried about you...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Blast. ...However, this is an 
absolute crisis for a maiden.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Sorry to keep you waiting, I 
bought it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai, it looked so good on you! Glad we 
solved this maiden's crisis!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sorry for making you worry. 
...And with that, case closed♪
